gaps.explanation: No missing line: every p4 fund column is in detail (General p8, ARPA p9, Keno Lottery p10, Papillion Landing p11, Papio Bay p12 budget schedules; Debt Service and Capital Projects p4 columns already added by pass 1, = printed column totals 5,013,469 and 14,117,375). The 11,099,856 gap is the printed budgetary vs GAAP difference: General p8 budgetary Total revenues 34,842,738 vs p4 General column 45,944,708 (-11,101,970; mainly 'Taxes - city sales' p8 2,105,515 vs p4 13,161,114) + Keno Lottery p10 919,818 vs p4 922,763 (-2,945) + Papillion Landing p11 2,493,696 vs p4 2,488,637 (+5,059); ARPA 195,541 and Papio Bay 374,835 tie. -11,101,970 - 2,945 + 5,059 = -11,099,856; 57,957,472 + 11,099,856 = 69,057,328 = p4 total. Adding GAAP-column lines for funds that have a budget schedule would count the same revenue twice.

No missing fund column. Budgetary schedules vs p4 GAAP columns: General p8 36,853,351 vs p4 37,185,628 (-332,277; p4 also prints Leases Principal payments 24,631, Interest on leases 4,449, Subscription payments 88,539, Interest on subscriptions 2,716 that p8 does not print, the rest is budgetary basis - the p8 lines cannot be split to isolate a printed remainder); Keno Lottery p10 324,730 vs p4 328,363 (-3,633); Papillion Landing p11 2,764,733 vs p4 2,793,133 (-28,400; p4 includes lease principal 4,048 and interest 76); Papio Bay p12 554,208 vs p4 551,862 (+2,346); Debt Service and Capital Projects tie (8,555,241; 11,516,868). -332,277 - 3,633 - 28,400 + 2,346 = -361,964; 60,569,131 + 361,964 = 60,931,095 = p4 total. Funds with their own budget schedule do not get GAAP-column lines (that would mix bases and double count).

The 191,789 already counted as this gap's schedule_total is Papillion Landing 'Insurance proceeds' (p11 schedule, = p4 column), which is not debt and which the JSON keeps in other_financing (6,778 + 191,789 = 198,567). Non-transfer other-financing detail after the fix = 310,345 + 191,789 = 502,134 = debt_proceeds 310,345 + other_financing 198,567 - 6,778: the p4 General 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets' 6,778 is already in detail as the p8 revenue line 'Proceeds from auction' 6,778 (same printed amount, same money, shown as revenue by the budget schedule), so it is not added again.
